notes_for_editor: Only one source names this site: the FFLOS Virginia list, which files it under Unconfirmed Sites with type Unconfirmed and status Unknown. The town article is background only. Searches turned up High Knob (a separate Wise County lookout) rather than anything at Coeburn, so do not merge the two. The FFLOS list has other Wise County entries near these coordinates, Wise Mountain (36.94287, -82.50869, Tower Gone) and Bull Hill (36.94327, -82.37850, Tower Gone). No source links them to Coeburn; a human could check. The record's kind and status stay unknown.
